draft_en.subject: PoE switches for your video-surveillance resellers
draft_en.body:
Hello,

Saga Telecom supplies PoE and L2+ switches to security and network distributors in Europe - under our label or the distributor's own. Your network-components line already lists several switch types; what we add is a PoE line priced for camera projects and sold at distributor level.

Reference points: STC-424XGGPM-280W (24 x GE PoE+ 280 W + 4 x 10G SFP+, Marvell L2+) USD 170; STC-2224GP (24 x GE PoE+ + 2 x GE + 2 x SFP, 300 W, unmanaged) USD 86; 8-port PoE+ units from USD 28, all EXW Shenzhen, snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days, CE/RoHS/REACH, 12-month warranty. Voice/camera VLAN, PoE watchdog and 250 m extend mode included where relevant.

Could you forward this to the product manager for video surveillance, or tell me who that is so I can send the full price sheet directly?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
